Ali swore the Prophet promised him that only a believer would love him and only a hypocrite would bear him a grudge.
The Prophet told Ali he was to him as Aaron to Moses, without prophethood after him, and at Khaybar gave him the standard as one loving and loved by Allah.
Ordered to abuse Ali, Sahl b. Sa'd told how the Prophet found Ali asleep in the mosque covered in dust and called him Abu Turab, the name Ali loved most.
